garcia.verdict: Garcia multi-region design can support Class B if mid-temporal and/or angular gyrus samples are present with usable cell counts. Prioritized MCA ROIs: ['mid-temporal cortex', 'angular gyrus']. Prefrontal cortex must be split or treated as mixed.

normal_tissue.description: Normal cerebral cortex from tailored lobectomies for epilepsy (n donors with scRNA ≈ 5 for normal arm contributing 74,535 cells before AVM joint atlas).
normal_tissue.region_granularity: Reported as cerebral cortex; epilepsy lobectomies are frequently temporal — exact lobe per donor requires table S1 / dbGaP phs002624.
normal_tissue.territorial_implication: If predominantly temporal neocortex → MCA-dominant prior. If frontal/parietal mix without labels → cannot support clean Class B.
normal_tissue.access: dbGaP phs002624.v2.p1 (controlled); UCSC cell browser adult-brain-vasc.cells.ucsc.edu; Zenodo cited in Science for objects

avm_tissue.description: Intraoperative angiographically confirmed AVMs (5 donors; 106,853 cells reported for AVM arm).
avm_tissue.region_granularity: Lesion-centric (nidus), not cytoarchitectonic region — territorial indexing may use AVM arterial feeder territory if recorded clinically.
avm_tissue.role: H4 disease de-differentiation / zonation loss; not naive territorial identity discovery.

winkler.recommendation: Do not assign Winkler normal cells to MCA until lobe-level metadata are verified. Garcia mid-temporal + angular gyrus are the current best open Class B MCA candidates.

overall_recommendation.class_b_primary_source: Garcia ROSMAP mid-temporal cortex and angular gyrus
overall_recommendation.class_b_aca_source: Yang superior frontal (empirically ACA) and/or Garcia medial-leaning PFC if split; HO frontal medial cortex as anatomical target
overall_recommendation.class_a_pca: Yang hippocampus + Garcia hippocampus + Garcia entorhinal (secondary)
overall_recommendation.winkler_role: H4 AVM + zonation reference; Class B only after lobe metadata verification
blocking_items: Winkler table S1 / dbGaP lobe labels
